hooks.command: file=$(cat | python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get("tool_input",{}).get("file_path",""))'); case "$file" in *.py) python3 -m py_compile "$file" ;; *.ts|*.vue|*.js) if [ -d "$(dirname "$file")/../node_modules" ] || [ -d frontend/node_modules ]; then (cd frontend && npx --no-install eslint --fix "${file#frontend/}" 2>&1 || true); fi ;; esac
set -e; python3 -m compileall backend -q; if [ -d frontend/node_modules ]; then (cd frontend && npm run build); else echo 'frontend/node_modules missing, skipping frontend build check'; fi
